title: Ferdinand the Catholic to Jerónimo de Vich, AHN Estado 8715 N.45 (1511), N.57 and N.60 (1512), in the 1511-12 nomenclator

steps.what: PARES search 'Vich cifrada' listed the ciphered letters; images fetched.
Aligned N.46 and N.52BIS with their clerk decipherments to rebuild alphabet and common groups.
N.57 read with the rebuilt key.
N.45 read; key extended, fug/fuq and plort corrected.
N.60 read; key at 153 groups.
Terrateig 1963 searched by snippet; dates not found, book not seen.
Clear subscriptions give place and date matching the catalogue; content fits Ravenna, the 1511 promotion, the Navarre bulls.

N.41 (22 May 1510) cipher transcribed (109 lines, 2,758 tokens) with its clerk decipherment (n41_clear.txt); 8714 N.39 (13 May 1510, 1,365 tokens) and N.12 (30 Sep 1508, 720 tokens) images fetched from PARES, cipher and clerk decipherment transcribed. 8714 N.26 has one clear image only, no cipher online.

Aligned N.41, N.39 and N.12 with their decipherments (n41_align.tsv, n39_align.tsv, n12_align.tsv): all three use the 1511-12 key unchanged; ~85 new code groups (poi rey de francia, pum Roma, plirt ni, sol todos, gue alla, mox principes, pep remedio, fil ellos, sul tambien ...) and new signs q1=a, 11h=l, 6h=u, qto=l, B8=b, pi=m; N, /, 9to are sentence marks. Added to decode.py.

Re-decoded N.45/N.57/N.60 with the extended key and measured with measure.py (token coverage) and measure_sense.py (decoded words attested in Villa Memorias + Quijote + clerk texts). Token coverage N.45 0.977->0.983, N.57 0.969->0.974, N.60 0.933->0.940; sense words 0.855/0.860/0.802. Still open: '2' (101x, N.60 only), flort (56; conflicting me / confederacion), gz 37, phi 36, reg, fiy, mat, goi, none of which occur in the deciphered siblings.

N.60 re-transcribed from the images (v2, 11,592 tokens): old '2' = & (y), &2 = x; flort liga, fiy favor, fuy exercito, mat obligado added. q/q1 split applied to N.45 and N.57 (151 q checked, 69 -> q1). Token coverage N.45 0.984, N.57 0.976, N.60 0.948; sense words 0.858/0.865/0.824. gz, phi, reg, goi still open; pp. 7-15 of N.60 read only at 2x.
N.60 pp. 7-15 proofread at 4x (v3, 35 corrections). Coverage 0.948 unchanged, sense 0.824; gz/phi/reg/goi/sid still open. L1522-L1530 not viewed.

Zurita, Historia del rey don Fernando lib. X (IFC PDF) searched: it narrates N.60's outcomes (interdict on France, Guyenne and Normandy absolved, Sforza in Milan) but prints no letter text. Terrateig 1963 and Doussinague 1944 not online; web searches found no transcription.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 21747 tokens, 234 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -2.09 per letter; random keys -3.69 (z 9.0); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.588 (mean -2.596, z 75.0); annealer on the real text -2.228. Verdict: pass.

Entry split under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): N.73 (1515, another system) moved to targets/vich1515/ with its transcription and solver scripts. Fraction re-measured on N.45/N.57/N.60 alone with measure.py (N.60 v3): 21,750 of 22,538 tokens (0.965).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): N.45 (v2), N.57 (v2) and N.60 (v3) linked to the glyph-label transcriptions measure.py counts and their decode.py outputs; key_file key.md and decode.py

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test, 22 Oct 2026): n45_pp*_v2_decoded.txt, n57_decode_v4.txt and n60_v3_decoded.txt read through. All three are raw decoder output with broken word division, wrong letters and bracketed groups on most lines (20-32% of sentences clean in docs/_check_reading.py); the gist is recoverable, the sentences are not built. All three relabelled decoded, not read; class read in part -> not read, method -> not solved, key stays partial; fraction_read 0.965 -> 0.

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, b16): all PARES images of N.45 (16), N.57 (4) and N.60 (16) opened, including the wrappers, blank pages and addresses not looked at before: no decipherment, interlinear or slip on any record; N.57's last three cipher lines and clear subscription are on f. 1v. A PARES search for neighbouring records returned HTTP 429.

Doubtful spots re-checked on the line strips at every break of sense: N.57 11 label corrections (oto in 'segun quan', plort/plart, the tilde-d = a six times), N.45 33 (the transcriber's fid merged fid despues and fud dicho, 17x; plix is plirt ni, 7x), N.60 5 (n57/n45a/n45b/n60_corrections.tsv; corrected files n57_transcription_v3, n45_pp*_v3, n60_transcription_v4).

Open groups resolved where one value fits every occurrence across N.45/N.57/N.60 and the siblings (b16_vich_kwic.py; key.md 'b16 additions'): goe aca (11), gix capitan (8; 'el gran capitan' x3), goi aquel (16), sid son (12), hoe governar (3), fet fue (15), Vs ss (17); gz and ang classed as clause marks. Rejected for a contradicting occurrence: pih querer, fob fortaleza, plix o, 7o rr, phi, reg, sil, sig.

From the N.45 and N.60 re-reads: gid amor (carried by 8714 N.39's decipherment 'palabras de grande amor'), sas ver, ree poder, sue saber, men menester, each fitting all occurrences; soi, dup, fez, dop, pog, hug, pie, dax proposed and not adopted.

Each letter built line by line into words in the figures' spelling (n45/n57/n60_build.txt), the reading generated with orthography modernised (b16_vich_make.py) and aligned word by word with its decode (b16_vich_align.py): N.45 3,968 of 3,984 words carried, N.57 431 of 433, N.60 5,026 of 5,074 (the rest checked by eye). Translations n45/n57/n60_en.md.

_check_reading.py on the reading bodies, kept in the figures' 1511 spelling (a first pass modernised the orthography and was reverted, 23 Oct): N.45 0.488 (raw decode 0.213), N.57 0.371 (0.30-0.32), N.60 0.386 (0.197); the word list lacks the period spelling, so counting explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1): N.45 0.697, N.57 0.800, N.60 0.591. N.45 and N.57 set read, grade B, after a sentence-by-sentence check; N.60 stays decoded, not read, its reading kept as partial.

r2i: N.60 pp. 4-14 proofread sign by sign against the v4 labels on 4x LANCZOS bands of the PARES images (owed since b16). 140 rules in n60_corrections_r2i.tsv, applied by research/reading_audit/r2i_n60fix.py -> n60_transcription_v5.txt (139 lines changed): inverted-T (o) labelled X about 100x (every 'oo X', 49, none in N.41/N.45/N.57; Ludouico, Fernando, casando, pension, sospecha, podria), the h-sign split as 'o X' (10), pob for poh (5), rof for ror (5), qto for barred q + to in Maximiliano (4), rug/rig, sub/fub, a struck group, three ink blots.

r2i: key values from the corrected labels, each checked at every occurrence in N.45/N.57/N.60 and the siblings: poh = quanto (14; carried by N.41's decipherment 'de quanto le cumpliere'), fub = dan (17; pue-dan, que-dan-do, ayudando, les dan; replaces 'daño'), ror = parece (5/5 'me parece que'), soi = tanto (8/8 once L0601 reads 'tanto quanto durare'). Adopted in decode.py, key.md 'r2i additions'. Not adopted: pub suizos (11/13), fez gasto, dup contrario, fob fortalezas (5/7 each).

r2i: N.60 build revised in 31 lines, reading regenerated (b16_vich_make.py), aligned on v5 (41 unbracketed words under 0.6 carried, 64 on v4); v2_score 0.572 -> 0.589 explicit holes, 0.381 -> 0.392 plain. Under the 0.60 bar: N.60 stays decoded, not read. N.45/N.57 builds take fub (pue-dan, 2 places): N.45 0.668, N.57 0.771 explicit holes, unchanged class.
Read bar applied per document (v10): 2 of 2 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The nomenclator was rebuilt by aligning N.46 and N.52BIS, sibling letters in the same Vich file (AHN Estado 8715) that carry the clerk's decipherment on the following leaves, with their cipher, and extended from N.41, 8714 N.39 and N.12 (also deciphered at the time). Re-read 22-23 Oct 2026 (b16): N.45 and N.57 built into sentences on that key with twelve more group values recovered from their occurrences across the letters (one, gid amor, carried by N.39's decipherment); N.60 stays decoded, not read.

texts.label: AHN Estado 8715 N.45, Seville, 4 Apr 1511
texts.summary: Ferdinand the Catholic to his ambassador Jerónimo de Vich in Rome: a long complaint against Julius II (the new cardinals, the absolution of the Venetians, the Pope's refusal of his counsel) and instructions to press the Emperor-Venice concord, settle Ferrara and deliver orders to Fabrizio Colonna. The decode is mechanical, unread groups in brackets.

reading_review.note: No decipherment, copy or edition found (PARES record and all 16 images opened; Terrateig 1963 unseen). Read line by line on the figures with the 1511-12 key extended in b16 (key.md 'b16 additions': goe, gix, goi, sid, hoe, fet, Vs, gid, sas, ree, sue, men; gid carried by 8714 N.39's decipherment, the rest by sense at every occurrence), 33 labels corrected on the images (fid/fud merged 17x, plix = plirt 7x; n45a/n45b_corrections.tsv); built in n45_build.txt in the figures' spelling, which the reading keeps. Aligned word by word (n45_align.tsv): 3,984 unbracketed words, 3,968 carried, 16 checked by eye. Reading kept in the figures' 1511 spelling (23 Oct 2026): _check_reading on the body 0.488 (182/373; its word list lacks the period spelling; raw decode 0.213), explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1) 0.697 (260/373); read sentence by sentence, coherent with 2-3 holes in the failing windows. Holes: ~424 [..], densest on pp. 3, 4 and 7 (unkeyed groups hno, hug, mun, myn, moy, cx, pie, pog, hng, sab, reg ...; number signs); the fac dichas/dar split flagged.

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 89.3% of the words of n45_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: AHN Estado 8715 N.57, Burgos, 5 June 1512
texts.summary: The aftermath of Ravenna: Ferdinand reconstructs how Vich's letters and the papal side pushed the viceroy Ramón de Cardona into battle against his orders, tells Vich not to do it again, and asks that the Ferrara business be treated secretly, 'sin que la sienta el Papa'.

reading_review.note: No decipherment found (PARES record and all 4 images opened). Read line by line on the figures with the 1511-12 key extended in b16 (here aca, governar, son, fue), 11 labels corrected on the half-line strips (n57_corrections.tsv: oto in 'segun quan', plort/plart, and the tilde-d = a six times, flagged for review); built in n57_build.txt in the figures' spelling, which the reading keeps. Aligned word by word (n57_align.tsv): 433 unbracketed words, 431 carried, 2 two-letter words checked by eye. Reading kept in the figures' 1511 spelling (23 Oct 2026): _check_reading on the body 0.371 (13/35; period spelling the word list lacks; raw decode 0.30-0.32), explicit holes only (b17_score.py HOLES=1) 0.800 (28/35); read sentence by sentence, coherent. Holes: 24 [..] (hno, rih, poh, fap, rar, mon, mug, sig x2, dup, pih, phi x2, sab, feg, for, pub, gud and three stray letter runs) and 8 [?words].

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 92.8% of the words of n57_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

texts.label: AHN Estado 8715 N.60, Logroño, 1 Sept 1512
texts.summary: Written from the Navarre campaign: a reproach to Julius II for not paying his troops as the League requires, and the plan for the Sforza restoration in Milan, Massimiliano son of Duke Ludovico to be put into the state by the Emperor's hand.
texts.note: Decoded, not read: re-read 22-23 Oct 2026 (b16) and proofread sign by sign 23 Oct 2026 (r2i). n60_reading.md is kept as a partial reading (n60_en.md, n60_reread_log.md). r2i: pp. 4-14 read against the v4 labels on 4x bands; 140 correction rules (n60_corrections_r2i.tsv) -> n60_transcription_v5.txt, chiefly the inverted-T (o) labelled X in about 100 places, the h-sign split as 'o X' (10), pob for poh (5), rof for ror (5), qto for barred q + to (4); key values added: poh quanto (carried by N.41's decipherment), fub dan, ror parece, soi tanto (each fits every occurrence). 31 build lines revised. Score (v2_score.py, every [?]/supplied word a hole): 0.572 -> 0.589 explicit holes (287/487), plain 0.381 -> 0.392; words under 0.6 carried 64 -> 41. Still under the bar: about 600 holes are code groups (phi 34, reg 18, pub 14, fez, dup, fob, for, pog, pir) that no sibling decipherment carries and no one value fits at every occurrence. Blocker: no-key-material; Terrateig 1963 (needs-physical-access) may print the decipherment.
